line: An old night train makes its last run, from a snowy mountain halt through a long tunnel to the sea, its lit windows going out one by one at the end of the line.
line_cn: 一列老夜车跑最后一趟：从雪山小站穿过长隧道开到海边，到站后车窗一扇扇熄灭。

transitions: Transitions: dissolves (0.5–1.2 s), an iris, light off/on, a near-plane curtain whose halves meet exactly.
labels: Text in the picture is paper: titles, letters, poems and captions are cut strips inside the box, revealed by growing from an anchor edge (scale the texture repeat with the mesh so glyphs aren't squashed), with an optional small seal.
Chinese: an OFL brush font (e.g. Ma Shan Zheng) for titles, a running script for handwriting, Noto Serif SC for subtitles. Latin: an OFL serif (e.g. Cormorant) at similar weight.
Subtitles are quiet and burned in: warm off-white serif, soft shadow, fading in just before the line. Where they sit depends on the framing:
box framing: under the box, on the dark of the room (serif 500, ~40 px CJK / ~38 px Latin, ~74 px from the bottom);
motion: Everything moves like paper on a stick: layers slide (x/y), rotate about a pivot, scale in from 0 along one axis ("written out"), or light up. No squash and stretch, no morphing, no bending.

Figures are optional. A film can tell its story with lit windows, vehicles, lamps and objects, and have no figure at all. When it has figures, they are jointed silhouettes: a body sheet + separate limb sheets anchored at the joint; animate rotation only.
Light cues are the big motion: the source, then each layer's translucency in a ~0.4 s stagger, then windows, then flicker (1 + .06·sin(7.3t)·sin(3.1t)).
Hard action lands on spoken words (use whisper word timings): an object slams, a character flashes, a light arc grows on its word.

native_moves.name: The lamp turns on
native_moves.does: Source, then far layers, then windows light up one by one.
native_moves.fits: a shop opening at dawn; a startup's first customer; a stadium before a match.

native_moves.name: Two windows, one light
native_moves.does: Two lit places sharing one light source (a moon, a lighthouse, a satellite).
native_moves.fits: a long-distance friendship; two labs working on the same problem; a sister city pair.

native_moves.name: Depth as distance
native_moves.does: A stack of ranges or streets makes "far away" visible; travel moves layers at speeds proportional to depth.
native_moves.fits: a migration route; shipping a parcel; the history of a river.

native_moves.name: Paper that writes itself
native_moves.does: A strip grows from its edge on the spoken word.
native_moves.fits: a recipe; the terms of a treaty; a child's first word.

native_moves.name: The box as keepsake
native_moves.does: The camera finds the real lamp in a room, real objects lit by its spill.
native_moves.fits: a wedding anniversary; a product unboxing; a museum object's story.

native_moves.name: Light burst from an opened thing
native_moves.does: A lid lifts and analytic glow spills out.
native_moves.fits: a gift; a discovery; a new idea.

native_moves.name: Silhouette in a window
native_moves.does: One figure inside a lit frame, or none: a lit window alone is enough.
native_moves.fits: someone working late; a portrait of a craftsperson; a patient waiting.

score.note: instruments like light behind paper: zither, bamboo flute, music box; no drum kit
